version_2_note: Adds current post-opening LTA evidence for CC30/CC31/CC32 (the official Circle Line 6 project page confirming completed opening) alongside the original pre-opening public-preview announcement, which is retained rather than removed. All seven identity resolutions from version 2026-09-13.1 are unchanged.
decision_horizon_note: No separately labelled forward-looking scenario has been approved, so the decision horizon equals the analysis cutoff. No station is treated as accessible before its own confirmed opening date.
scope_note: This registry resolves only the seven S005 code-only station labels found in the 2026-09-12 snapshot (DT4, CC9, NE18, CC30, DT18, CC31, CC32). It is not a nationwide re-verification of every named MRT/LRT complex.
non_proximity_rule: Every merge or rename below is justified by an official LTA station-code or opening-date designation, not by exit coordinates alone. Coordinates are reported only as corroborating context.

overrides.rationale: CC9 is LTA's official, long-standing Circle Line station code for the existing Paya Lebar interchange station (interchange code EW8/CC9), independent of the exits' proximity to the existing named complex.
overrides.operational_status_basis: Long-operating Circle Line interchange station; current official LTA Circle Line page lists Paya Lebar as station CC9 between Dakota (CC8) and MacPherson (CC10).
overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The two CC9-labelled exits (MRT_EXIT_21218, MRT_EXIT_21219) sit within about 100 m of the four existing PAYA LEBAR MRT STATION exits (Exit A-D), consistent with but not the basis for this merge.

evidence.title: Circle Line
evidence.description: Official LTA Circle Line page listing Paya Lebar as station CC9, between Dakota (CC8) and MacPherson (CC10).

overrides.rationale: DT18 is LTA's official Downtown Line station code for the existing Telok Ayer station, which opened with Downtown Line Stage 1 in December 2013, independent of the exits' proximity to the existing named complex.
overrides.operational_status_basis: Official LTA news release confirms Downtown Line Stage 1, including Telok Ayer, commenced service on 22 December 2013, long before the 2026-09-12 analysis cutoff.
overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The two DT18-labelled exits (MRT_EXIT_21248 Exit E, MRT_EXIT_21250 Exit D) are within about 60 m of the three existing TELOK AYER MRT STATION exits (Exit A-C) and continue the same A-E exit-letter sequence, consistent with but not the basis for this merge.

evidence.title: Three New Stations to Connect Downtown Line to North-South Line (background on Downtown Line Stage 1 opening)
evidence.description: Official LTA release referencing Downtown Line Stage 1 (Bugis, Promenade, Bayfront, Downtown, Telok Ayer, Chinatown) commencing service on 22 December 2013.

overrides.rationale: DT4 is the official LTA code for Hume MRT Station, a standalone new station fitted into the existing Downtown Line at a previously provisioned station box between Hillview and Beauty World.
overrides.operational_status_basis: Official LTA news release confirms Hume station opened for passenger service at 3pm on 28 February 2025, before the 2026-09-12 analysis cutoff.
overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The two DT4-labelled exits sit in the Hume Avenue / Bukit Batok West corridor between Hillview and Beauty World, consistent with the announced location.

evidence.title: Hume Station to Open on 28 February 2025
evidence.description: Official LTA press release confirming Hume MRT station on the Downtown Line opened for passenger service at 3pm on 28 February 2025.

overrides.rationale: NE18 is the official LTA code for Punggol Coast MRT Station, the new North East Line terminus beyond the existing Punggol station.
overrides.operational_status_basis: Official LTA news releases confirm Punggol Coast station opened for passenger service at 3pm on 10 December 2024, before the 2026-09-12 analysis cutoff.
overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The two NE18-labelled exits sit in the Punggol Digital District area north-east of the existing Punggol station, consistent with the announced location.

evidence.title: Punggol Coast Station to Open for Passenger Service from 10 December 2024
evidence.description: Official LTA press release announcing Punggol Coast station would open 10 December 2024 as the new North East Line terminus.

evidence.title: Factsheet: Punggol Coast Station Welcomes Commuters from 10 December 2024
evidence.description: Official LTA factsheet confirming Punggol Coast station opened for passenger service on 10 December 2024.

overrides.rationale: CC30 is the official LTA code for Keppel MRT Station, one of three new Circle Line Stage 6 (CCL6) stations that closed the Circle Line loop between HarbourFront and Marina Bay.
overrides.operational_status_basis: Official LTA news release confirms Circle Line Stage 6, including Keppel, Cantonment and Prince Edward Road stations, opened for passenger service on 12 July 2026, before the 2026-09-12 analysis cutoff.
overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The three CC30-labelled exits sit in the Keppel Road / HarbourFront-area corridor consistent with the announced CCL6 alignment.

overrides.coordinate_corroboration: The four CC31-labelled exits sit in the Tanjong Pagar / Cantonment Road corridor consistent with the announced CCL6 alignment.
